review_description: Very happy with Oasis. They've never let us down and have been fantastic!

These guys/girl ticked all the boxes!No spiffy commission oriented sales person just one of the actual installers (electrician) - after 4 previous quotes from other companies this was a welcome relief!Efficient, tidy, punctual professional InstallationAmazing after installation customer service. Not only helping with grid connection but also constantly monitoring my solar input and efficiency over a year after installation.Just cant speak highly enough of this company

We have had 2 jobs completed by Oasis (1 solar project, and 1 electrical) and both times Mikaela and the crew have been professional and well-priced. We will definitely use them again and recommend them to others.

Oasis came in the middle of the three quotes I received, and they had good references for previous similar works in my area. Oh, and they have been in business since the 90’s. (So definitely not a fly by night company) Once the job was complete, the quality of the install was obvious. Another sparkie mate couldn’t fault any of their work, and all they promised with the system and batteries has worked. I haven’t had a power bill in 2 years. Jake and Mikayla are brilliant to deal with, and have checked in to see I’m still happy a year after the install. There’s so many dodgy Solar mobs, but Oasis aren’t one of them. Five stars from a very satisfied customer. ??????????
Excellent before and after service. Great advice on what would suit us. Installers were respectful, on time, used good quality products. Highly recommend

Quoting process with Mikaela was top notch. She responded promptly and wasn't shy to have a phone call and hear out all my queries. We went back and forth a couple of times for different proposals and they sent out their electrician, Billy, to check out our place.Billy knew exactly what was going on. I had another 3 installers shy away from in-wall installation of conduit because it was "a bit more work and too hard". Being an electrician myself, this instantly turned me away from the other installers but Billy was no-nonsense with his "I wouldn't want external conduit on my house either" attitude.All in all, they were flexible with me providing my own inverter for the install (brand new through my own trade account) and the install was neat and fully functional. Sign offs and documentation were concise and the team at Oasis were respectful of our time and my wife and 4 kids on the day of install.Great work guys, can't recommend you more if I tried. Will be putting your name out to mates who need solar/AC in the future.
